meta.name: Bombing Brighton: The Plot to Kill Thatcher
meta.description: Bombing Brighton: The Plot to Kill Thatchertakes a look at the Brighton Bombing of 1984, where the Irish Republican Army (IRA) attempted to assassinate members of the British government, including the prime minister, Margaret Thatcher, at the Grand Hotel in Brighton, England. The film features the man who planted the bomb, Patrick Magee.
